prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A group of scientists stands in a modern, high-tech laboratory, their attention focused intently on a transparent digital display in the foreground. The central subject is an Asian woman with a sleek, chin-length black bob haircut, wearing a crisp white lab coat over a deep blue shirt. Her expression is calm, intelligent, and contemplative, with a subtle hint of determination as she studies the data projected before her. Soft, cool lighting bathes the scene, creating a clinical, futuristic atmosphere, while a faint blue lens flare cuts across her face, emphasizing the presence of advanced technology. In the background, other scientists in white lab coats are slightly out of focus, their features blurred to draw attention to the main subject. The color palette is dominated by whites, blues, and subtle greys, enhancing the sterile, cutting-edge feel of the environment. The composition uses a shallow depth of field and a medium close-up angle, giving the image a cinematic, almost sci-fi quality, as if capturing a pivotal moment of discovery or analysis in a visionary research facility.
